subject: SmallBank: production queueing, elevated errors, reserved throughput shortfall
messages:
From: Alex Brown <alex.brown@smallbank.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:33:00 -0700
Subject: Production: increased latency, 5xx errors and token queueing

Hi Priyom,

We're seeing sustained queueing on our reserved capacity this morning — median latency has doubled and a subset of requests are returning 502/504. This started around 08:30 PDT and is impacting our nightly reconciliation jobs. Our engineers report long token-queue lengths and occasional KV cache misses.

Can you confirm whether the dedicated GPU pool assigned to SmallBank has any active throttles or recent config changes? This is blocking critical batch jobs and we need ETA on remediation.

I've attached a short sample of the error trace and a small metrics dump.

- Alex
Alex Brown
SRE Lead | SmallBank
Attachments: error-trace-sample.txt (text), metrics_snapshot_20270529.csv (csv)
From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@smallbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:48:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Production: increased latency, 5xx errors and token queueing

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts, appreciate the quick capture.

Quick notes:
- I'm seeing an elevated queue depth against your reserved throughput window and a surge of short-sequence traffic from a newly-deployed endpoint (recon-processor-v2).
- No recent config changes on our side to the allocation; autoscaler did report several fast scale-ins overnight on that pool (we're investigating).

Immediate plan:
1) I'll open an ops bridge and loop in our pool on-call to snapshot kernel/timer metrics and confirm whether any throttles/fallbacks triggered.
2) Suggesting a short mitigation: temporarily increase your reserved throughput + enable a soft fallback to the compatible model-quantized variant for the recon batch job to reduce per-token latency.
3) I'll send you a timeline and invite for a bridge within 30 minutes.

I've attached the metrics you sent and a short CSV I generated that highlights the token-queue histogram.

- Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | priyom_das@redwood.com
Attachment: metrics_snapshot_20270529.csv (annotated)
From: priyom_das@redwood.com <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: URGENT: SmallBank reserved throughput shortfall — exec involvement requested

Team — looping you both in. SmallBank (SBK-5481) reports active queueing and 502/504s on their dedicated pool; impact is hitting nightly reconciliation and a couple of front-office endpoints. Timeline: started ~08:30 PDT.

Why this needs exec attention now:
- Their reserved throughput is not meeting observed demand; proposal to briefly increase commit to avoid job failures will affect inventory across the pool and we may need to reassign headroom from non-critical reserved groups.
- If we can't provide a quick throughput uplift, SmallBank will escalate formally to their CIO and threaten a pause on a renewal conversation scheduled next quarter.

Short actions I recommend (we can decide on bridge):
- Immediate: approve a one-time 2x throughput burst on SmallBank's dedicated pool for next 4 hours and enable soft fallback to quantized variant for recon-processor-v2. This is reversible.
- Ops: run a root-cause snapshot and share kernel-level metrics (NVLink utilization, GPU util, queue depths, kernel stall counters).
- Sales/Exec: schedule a 30-min executive bridge with SmallBank leadership to show we're taking ownership and provide timeline for root cause and permanent remediation (e.g., reserved commit adjustment or pool rebalancing).

Attachments: annotated metrics (from Alex), short error sample. HubSpot: https://hubspot.redwood/contacts/lead/SBK-5481

Please advise if you approve the temporary burst and exec bridge.

- Priyom
From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Brown <alex.brown@smallbank.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 16:11:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: SmallBank reserved throughput shortfall — exec involvement requested

Thanks for the context, Priyom, and Alex for the quick reporting. I approve the temporary burst and fallback for the next 4 hours. Vivek — can you stand up an ops bridge now and pull the kernel/timer dumps Priyom requested? Karthis (Karthik), please prepare a short slide (3 bullets) showing options: 1) short-term burst + fallback, 2) medium-term reserved commit increase, 3) longer-term pool rebalancing + autoscaler tuning.

I'll join the bridge and be on the exec call if SmallBank's CIO wants to escalate. Priyom — please send calendar invite for 30 min bridge with Alex and their SRE lead; include the runbook and drive link.

Action items assigned:
- Ops (Vivek): immediate bridge and kernel metrics (ETA 15 min) — vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
- Product Ops (Karthik): options slide + cost delta for 1-day/1-week reserved bump (ETA 45 min) — karthik_iyer@redwood.com
- Sales (Priyom): schedule bridge, own communications and next steps with SmallBank (ETA 10 min) — priyom_das@redwood.com

Alex — we'll get this stabilized quickly and follow up with a short RCA and a path to prevent recurrence.

—
Marissa Cole
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: none
